text:
sarah: Quick check — where do we stand on trace hook rollout + retention gating? need clear owners for the canary next week

mike: I'm owning trace hooks. PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/432

julia: Dashboards side: migrated core error views to the new template, waiting on a tiny UX tweak + PR review @mike

mike: Got it — I'll review after lunch. CI is flaky on the e2e, seeing a timeout in the playback test

ashley: Retention policy proposal: default 30d for session traces, 90d for error aggregates. Legal needs to sign off for regulated customers (HIPAA/FINRA)

kevin: Storage dependency: schema bump required for retention index. @derek can you confirm migration window?

derek: Schema bump approved. Planned migration Tue 03/12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Writes will be paused for ~10m during the cutover.

sarah: OK — we need a rollback playbook and a canary checklist. @obs-bot can you create a short runbook for the canary deploy?

obs-bot: Runbook created: RB-2026-07 (https://internal.redwood/runbooks/RB-2026-07) — includes rollback steps, VM snapshot id, and who to page.

julia: Small ask — can someone approve dashboards PR #789 by EOD? it's just the color contrast tweak and a unit test.

mike: Leaving review comments now. Found one flaky selector, sending fix.

ashley: Legal signed off on the general policy except HIPAA customers — we need an opt-in flag in the console for those customers. Filed ticket OPS-1145.

kevin: Noted. I'll add the flag in the deployment config; will need a quick e2e to validate.

mike: Heads up: after the last batcher change I saw a small perf regression (~7% p50) in staging. Tracking in #perf — could impact latency SLO for the canary unless we tune batch size.

sarah: Thanks. Action items recap: mike owns trace hooks + perf tune, julia owns dashboards, ashley owns retention policy + legal liaison, derek owns migration window, kevin owns config flag + e2e. Everyone ack?

mike: ack

julia: ack

ashley: ack

derek: ack

kevin: ack — will review canary config tonight

sarah: Also pinging for a code review on canary config: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/101 — @kevin @mike please prioritize so we can start Monday 03:00 UTC if green

kevin: I'll review tonight; if green we can start canary Mon 03:00 UTC

mike: Scheduling a quick spike to test batcher params tonight. Will post results here.

sarah: Perfect. If anything blocks, drop a short note here. Adding the items to the sprint board now. :thumbsup:
